title: Crispy Buffalo Chicken Wontons
description: These Buffalo chicken wontons make a deliciously crispy, deep-fried appetizer with all the flavors of Buffalo chicken. Guaranteed to please a crowd!
ingredients: 1.5 teaspoons hot pepper sauce, or more to taste

steps.text: Heat vegetable oil in a deep fryer or large saucepan to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Combine chicken, Cheddar cheese, ranch dressing, butter, and hot sauce in a bowl. Scoop about 1 tablespoon of chicken mixture onto the center of each wonton wrapper; fold wontons in half and press to seal. Arrange wontons on a baking sheet and freeze for 5 to 10 minutes.
Lower wontons carefully into the hot oil in batches. Fry until golden brown, about 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain. Repeat with remaining wontons.

video.description:
If you’re an insatiable chicken wing lover but could do without all the sauce, 
you’ll go crazy for these compact handheld wonton pockets stuffed with all the 
buffalo flavor you crave. Combine chicken, Cheddar cheese, ranch dressing, 
butter and hot pepper sauce into a savory mixture, then scoop into wonton 
wrappers and fry until irresistibly crisp. Get the party started and serve these
crunch appetizers hot with blue cheese dressing, hot sauce and celery sticks, 
and pass the beers around!
video.name: Crispy Buffalo Chicken Wontons
